objective: Determine whether a user or system was targeted or affected by a phishing attempt and identify evidence of interaction or compromise.
investigation_steps: Identify the suspected phishing message, sender, recipient, and delivery time.
Review message headers and delivery metadata.
Identify URLs, domains, attachments, and other indicators contained in the message.
Determine whether the recipient opened the message or interacted with links or attachments.
Review authentication activity following suspected interaction.
Review endpoint or browser activity associated with the suspected phishing content.
Check identified domains, URLs, hashes, or files against available security intelligence.
Identify evidence gaps that prevent determining whether the phishing attempt resulted in compromise.
completion_criteria: User interaction with links or attachments investigated where evidence is available.
Post-interaction authentication and endpoint activity reviewed.
